title: pikpak error getting token
body:
pikpak seems to have canceled the oauth2 login, and the existing login is no longer valid...

Error: failed to retrieve token using username/password: oauth2: “invalid_argument” “currently not supported”

2024/08/15 17:46:47 Fatal error: failed to retrieve token using username/password: oauth2: “invalid_argument” “currently not supported”

rclone v1.67.0

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
As far as I know, this is because PikPak abandoned OAuth 2.0 for automatic login and reverted to the original login method, adding parameters like User-Agent, X-Device-ID, and X-Captcha-Token for handling the login process. However, these changes aren't too problematic. The bigger issue is that there's a certain probability of encountering CAPTCHA verification, which currently seems to require users to manually complete the verification via a hyperlink. This complicates automated processes, especially in command-line environments.

Currently, both Alist and the unofficial PikPakAPI for Python have implemented the new login adjustments. You might consider referring to their login methods, but the CAPTCHA verification issue still seems unsolvable for now and can only be handled manually.

Looking forward to hearing good news.

Can anyone try with [this](https://<redacted-host>/branch/fix-8005-pikpak-login/v1.68.0-beta.8242.9c0c543ee.fix-8005-pikpak-login/)?

I've made significant changes in this version. To try this out, you'll need to ensure you have a persistent `device_id` set up. Rclone will create it for you if it doesn't exist in rclone.conf.

Here is a list of changed options in the patched version.

* `client_id`: Updated and not configurable anymore
* `client_secret`: Deprecated as unused
* `user_agent`: New and defaults to `Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:129.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/129.0`. Override by `--pikpak-user-agent`
* `device_id`: New and randomly generated if unavailable. Do not delete or change it frequently.
* `captcha_token`: New and automatically managed by rclone like `token`
